# SHA-256 of the canonical definition of each privileged job of release.yml
# (job + workflow env/defaults/permissions). Regenerate in the same pull request
# as any change to them: python3 .github/scripts/checks/signing-key-isolation.py --print-hashes
# sign: signs each binary with the key, one job per asset
sign ca72de5042d7d706da91cb5d303e20daba88f3d7bf4170a7021c3139d9d491fb
# sign-packages: signs each package (.deb, .rpm, pacman) with the key, one job per package
sign-packages c5a1328263652dfceb8de1c6f311ac1477007abf93be1f6eda6616d7c4d3b901
# seal: gathers the whole set, checks it against the exact list of names, makes the checksums and
# signs the checksums, the SBOMs, the notices and the installers; holds the key, writes no release
seal ca0bd0a41a1b070d9b6760e23ff838d9cec91b88cffe78d51de35b8d25f24e3a
# attest: the only job that mints a token; attests build provenance
attest a670e2422daee06962f7b27525d996172acc7b6887c55fb1f9dc16cf19ded777
# release: publishes the sealed set after checking it again; has the right to write a release and no key,
# runs in a real release only, in the environment `release-publish`
release 903dd8cda3271161a220d4a7f7ddc34e574e39c5b6dfd8840eea63e935e73a5d
